summary: A multi-version queue simulator with demand-aware consumption, hash-tracked drains, and status reporting.

traps.quote: r is the unique integer in 0..1000000006 congruent to the signed value modulo 1000000007
traps.consequence: Negative remainder in hash, wrong final hash output
traps.guard: Map signed i64 to [0, MOD) using ((x % MOD) + MOD) % MOD

traps.quote: A value is consumed only if d>0; ... If d=0, draining stops before that value.
traps.consequence: Consumes one extra value, wrong m count and hash h
traps.guard: Before consuming any value, check d>0; skip consuming if d=0 without advancing c

traps.quote: An unpublished slot stops draining. A completion is consumed by advancing c. A value is consumed only if d>0.
traps.consequence: Wrong events consumed, incorrect m, p, c, d in final state
traps.guard: For slot at c, check in order: if unpublished stop; if completion consume; if value check d

traps.quote: Operation i creates version i from earlier version b; versions may branch.
traps.consequence: State mutations in base version leak to branches or vice versa, wrong output
traps.guard: Each version stores independent state for p, c, d, reservations, publications; branching copies, not shares

traps.quote: Status is COMPLETE if p=c=N; WAITING if c=p
traps.consequence: Wrong status output if conditions checked in wrong order or overlap
traps.guard: Ensure status logic checks all four conditions and returns exactly one; verify mutual exclusivity

traps.quote: Producer IDs are 1..N. Queue tickets 0..N-1. Producer s receives ticket p.
traps.consequence: Off-by-one errors mapping producer ID to slot, wrong values consumed
traps.guard: Keep producer ID (1-indexed) separate from ticket index (0-indexed); map s to slot s-1 when accessing

input_shape: N Q (producers, operations), then Q lines: R/W/D/P operations on N producers with demand up to 10^18.
output_shape: For each P (drain) operation: DRAIN m h status p c d where m, h are output count and hash.
invariants: Each producer reserves once, publishes once; cannot reserve or publish an unreserved or already-published producer
Version i is derived from version b<i; versions branch independently without affecting base version state
Draining consumes tickets starting at c in order until hitting unpublished, reaching c=p, or d=0 before a value
max_scale: N=150000 producers, Q=150000 operations, demand per ancestry up to 10^18.
